arabic text: MARA HAI FATEMA KO SABNE RULA RULA KAR
english translation text: EVERYONE HAS MADE FATIMA WEEP AGAIN AND AGAIN.

arabic text: ZAHRA KA DAR JALA KAR ZAHRA PE DAR GIRA KAR
english translation text: THEY BURNED THE DOOR OF ZAHRA, THEY PUSHED THE DOOR ONTO ZAHRA.

arabic text: TURBAT SE FATEMA KI ATI YEHI SADA HAI\nPEHLU SE HAATH MERA AB TAK NAHI HATA HAI\nMEHDI MUJHE SAMBHAALO MEHDI MUJHE SAMBHAALO GHAYBAT SE JALD AA KAR
english translation text: FROM FATIMA’S GRAVE, THIS CRY STILL RISES: 'MY HAND HAS\nNOT MOVED AWAY FROM MY BROKEN RIB TILL TODAY. O\nMAHDI, COME AND HOLD ME— O MAHDI, RETURN FROM OCCULTATION SOON.'

arabic text: DARBAAR SE ZAEEFA GHAR KI TARAF CHALI HAI\nALLAH HI JAANTA HAI KITNI DAFA GIRI HAI\nLAAYE HAI APNE GHAR TAK LAAYE HAI APNE GHAR TAK HASNAYN KHUD UTHA KAR
english translation text: THE WEAKENED LADY WALKS HOME FROM THE COURT. ONLY\nALLAH KNOWS HOW MANY TIMES SHE FELL. HASAN AND HUSAYN\nBROUGHT HER HOME— LIFTING HER WITH THEIR OWN HANDS.

arabic text: ZAALIM KA TAZIYANA JIS HAATH PAR LAGA HAI\nWO HAATH FATEMA KA UTH HI NAHI RAHA HAI\nPARHTI HAI AB NAMAAZEIN PARHTI HAI AB NAMAAZEIN IK HAATH HI UTHA KAR
english translation text: THE WHIP OF THE OPPRESSOR STRUCK HER BLESSED\nHAND— THAT HAND OF FATIMA CANNOT RISE ANYMORE.\nNOW SHE PERFORMS HER PRAYERS, LIFTING ONLY ONE HAND.

arabic text: PEHLU ME DARD ITNA SEH KAR TARAP RAHI HAI\nCHALNA BHI AB HAI MUSHKIL UTH UTH KE GIR RAHI HAI\nCHALTI HAI EK SHAANA CHALTI HAI EK SHAANA DEEWAAR SE LAGA KAR
english translation text: THE PAIN IN HER SIDE IS SO INTENSE, SHE TREMBLES WITH\nIT. WALKING HAS BECOME DIFFICULT—SHE KEEPS FALLING AGAIN AND AGAIN.\nSHE WALKS SLOWLY, LEANING HER SHOULDER AGAINST THE WALL FOR SUPPORT.

arabic text: KEHKE YATEEM KHUD KO SHABBIR JAB KE ROYE\nDO HAATH FATEMA KE BANDHE KAFAN SE NIKLE\nSEENE PE ROYI APNE SEENE PE ROYI APNE SHABBIR KO SULA KAR
english translation text: WHEN SHABBIR CRIED, CALLING HIMSELF AN ORPHAN, BOTH HANDS OF\nFATIMA EMERGED FROM HER SHROUD. SHE BROUGHT HUSAYN TO HER\nCHEST— SHE CRIED WHILE PUTTING HIM TO SLEEP ON HER CHEST.

arabic text: MANZAR BARA KATTHAN THA JIS DAM LAGA TAMACHA\nSAR BINTE MUSTAFA KA DEEWAAR SE LAGA THA\nMU PEET TE THE HAIDAR MU PEET TE THE HAIDAR AANKHON SE KHUN BAHA KAR
english translation text: IT WAS A HORRIFYING SCENE -WHEN THE SLAP STRUCK HER FACE.\nTHE HEAD OF THE DAUGHTER OF MUSTAFA STRUCK THE WALL.\nALI SLAPPED HIS FACE IN AGONY - BLOOD FLOWED FROM HIS EYES.

arabic text: HILNE LAGA NABI KA US DAM MAZAAR AASEE\nZAHRA LAHAD PE AAKAR RORO KE JAB PUKARI\nCHEHRE KE NEEL DEKHO CHEHRE KE NEEL DEKHO BABA RIDA HATA KAR
english translation text: AT THAT MOMENT, THE PROPHET’S GRAVE BEGAN TO TREMBLE. WHEN ZAHRA\nCAME TO HIS GRAVE, CRYING AND CALLING OUT— 'LOOK AT\nTHE BRUISES ON MY FACE, FATHER, REMOVE THE GRAVE-CLOTH AND SEE.'
